fato_historico: 1983: Soyuz 7K-ST No. 16L, intended to launch a crew to the Salyut 7 space station, explodes on the launch pad. The launch escape system is activated before the Soyuz-U rocket explodes, saving the crew.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle reminder that even when plans shift unexpectedly, your spirit remains untethered. Much like a sudden spark that clears the path for safety and wisdom, you are encouraged to trust your intuition. It is a good time to recalibrate your focus and find beauty in the resilience of your adventurous soul.
frase_do_dia: Even when the ground shakes, your spirit is destined to soar toward the stars.
significado_numero: Represents the grace found when navigating sudden changes and new beginnings.
conselho: Trust your inner escape system and keep moving forward with grace and optimism.
